title: Evaluation of a polynomial difference
statement: For any natural number $n$ and any two multilinear polynomials $F$ and $G$ on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube, the polynomial represented by their difference evaluates at each point of the cube to the difference of their evaluations.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ and $G$ are real coefficient families indexed by subsets of the coordinate set
